notes: Felling Blow, printed: 'Then that creature deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.' A negative power counts as 0 when an effect uses it as a number (CR 107.1b): seat 0's -3/4 Weakling gets the counter (-2/5) and deals 0 damage: seat 1's 4/4 has no damage marked and seat 1's life is unchanged (nothing is healed).
